Commander Buffs
===============

Commander Buffs
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. list-table::
   :header-rows: 1

   * - Buff Name
     - Cost
     - Description
     - Notes
   * - Frontline Zeal
     - Increasing
     - Increases damage by X% against Bulwark and Goose, increases Movement Speed by X%, damage dealt by X%, and escort movement speed by X%. 
     - **PERMANENT**. most important buff, must be prioritize to max ASAP
   * - Hair Pulling
     - 300
     - Increases allies' damage against Goose by 100% for 10 seconds 
     - must be used when preparing to do big number damages against Goose
   * - Sprint
     - 500
     - Increases movement speed when carrying the Fortune Tree by 100%
     - use this when carrying Fortune Tree going outside of enemy base, the faster the tree leaves the base the better
   * - Relentless Advance
     - 1000
     - Makes allies carrying the Fortune Tree ignore interception for 5 seconds 
     - combo with sprint if escorting thru battle or moving the tree outside the enemy base as enemy goose can interrupt carrier
   * - Last Stand
     - 1000
     - Reduces all allies' respawn time by 30% for 1 minute. **Last Stand**: When you are 2 turrets behind, reduces respawn time by 60% instead.
     - use when multiple allies are down for quicker recovery
   * - Bounty Strike
     - 1000
     - Increase all allies' damage to the enemy player moving the Fortune Tree by 40% for 10 seconds.
     - killing the carrier slows down Fortune Tree movement
   * - Desperate Surge
     - 500
     - Reduces all enemies' healing received by 60% for 15 seconds. 
     - use this when tank uses AoE Taunt as it's most likely a battle is about to happen
   * - You Got a Problem?
     - 300
     - Increase allies' damage against Bulwarks by 100% for 10 seconds
     - captains should request this buff from commander when committing to push Bulwark
   * - Refight
     - 2000
     - Reduces the remaining cooldowns of all allies' Martial Art Ultimates (EX variation of special skills) by 50% and increases the damage and healing dealt over the next 30 seconds by 10%. **Last Stand**: When you are 2 bulwarks behind, immediately resets the Martial Art Ultimate cooldowns of all allies instead
     - expensive but can be useful in certain scenarios
   * - City Protection
     - 1000
     - Protects all Bulwarks and the Goose from damage for 20 seconds
     - good for defense while all allies focuses on offense

Battlefield Item
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. list-table::
  :header-rows: 1

  * - Item
    - Cost
    - Description
    - Notes
  * - Boom Chicken
    - 300
    - After purchase, summon a Boom Chicken at your camp. Coordinated bombing on the same area increases explosion range and damage. Disappears after skill activation. Boom Chicken deals 3x damage to neutral targets. **Last Stand**: Damage increases to 6x.
    - Use it to deal heavy AoE damage. It also gives speed boost when carrying it.
  * - Horskie
    - 600
    - After purchase, summon a Horskie on the top, middle, or bottom lane. Mount lasts 60s and can charge at enemies. The Horskie will run away and disappear after using its skill or when the duration ends.
    - Can summon up to 6 Horskie.
  * - Ballista
    - 1200
    - After purchase, usable at the crossbow stations on the top, middle, and bottom lanes to launch yourself. Use Mighty Drop mid-air to land quickly and deal damage. One purchase grants 10 charges.
    - Can be used for quick response and deployment to wherever members are needed. Players can fly from home base to enemy base.

.. tip::

  - Restock the chicken bombs with using any extra fun coins. Any member should pick up one before leaving base to throw at enemy goose or bulwark. A chicken bomb buffed with **You Got a Problem?** or **Hair Pulling** can do 100k+ damage easy (*non-coordinated, so just imagine how much a coordinated bombing will do*)!
  - Buff timing is crucial. It can flip battles. Assigned Team Captain must communicate their situation to Commander clearly.
